prompt:
You describe a graph or chart from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What is plotted against what: for each axis, the quantity, the unit and the range (first and last tick labels).
2. Each curve or series: its label or condition (temperature, voltage, mode, ...) and its overall trend in words.
3. Values printed in the figure as text (annotations, labelled points, legend values). Do not estimate values from where a curve sits; if a value is not printed, describe the trend in words instead.

Figure type: graph or chart
Section: 1. Chip Description > 1.5 Transmitter RF Path > 1.5.1 Low Frequency Power Amplifier (LF PA) (LR20xx)
Caption: Figure 1-5: LF PA Tx Power and IDD Tx vs Targeted Power (915 MHz, 3.3 V SIMO)
Text inside the figure (read from this image by a specialised OCR model; use these spellings): x: Targeted Power (dBm), 10 to 22 | y: TX Power (dBm), 10 to 22 | y2: IDDTX (mA), 0 to 120
Text that mentions the figure: Figure 1-5 and Figure 1-6 below show the relationship between the LF PA output power and current consumption versus the targeted power at 3.3 V in SIMO configuration with these optimized settings for both Semtech 915 MHz reference design, and 490 MHz reference design respectively.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Graph of LF PA Tx Power and IDD Tx vs Targeted Power (915 MHz, 3.3 V SIMO).

The horizontal axis is Targeted Power (dBm), ranging from 10 to 22.
The left vertical axis is TX Power (dBm), ranging from 10 to 22.
The right vertical axis is IDDTX (mA), ranging from 0 to 120.

There are two curves:
- TX Power (dBm): This curve shows a generally increasing trend as Targeted Power increases.
- IDDTX (mA): This curve also shows a generally increasing trend as Targeted Power increases.

Text printed in the figure includes:
- x: Targeted Power (dBm), 10 to 22
- y: TX Power (dBm), 10 to 22
- y2: IDDTX (mA), 0 to 120
- Legend entries: TX Power (dBm) and IDDTX (mA).
